### About me

I'm a Software Engineer at AIBUILD and a graduate student in Information Technology at the University of Melbourne. I focus on Software and AI Engineering, stay curious, and continue exploring the broader field of Computer Science.

### Working on
- Multimodal AI agents
- Applied machine learning
- Scalable LLM workflows

### Hobbies
- Exploring new technologies, tools, and workflows  
- Reading cutting-edge research papers
- Enjoying Manga, anime, and calm, story-driven media  
- Building and polishing personal infrastructure (NAS, homelab, AI server, etc.)
